name: BANK-05 no arbitrary active standing-order cap

data.sql: DELETE FROM bank_orders WHERE player_id=(SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name='bank05_no_cap_owner');

tests.name: Seed 105 valid active orders as deterministic test fixture

data.sql: INSERT INTO bank_orders(player_id,kind,schedule,next_run_at,enabled,amount,currency,to_entity,to_id,memo,frequency,utc_hour,utc_minute,weekday,month_day) SELECT p.player_id,'recurring','daily',CURRENT_TIMESTAMP+INTERVAL '1 day',TRUE,1,'CRD','player',r.player_id,'acceptance fixture '||g,'daily',12,0,NULL,NULL FROM players p CROSS JOIN players r CROSS JOIN generate_series(1,105) AS g WHERE p.name='bank05_no_cap_owner' AND r.name='bank05_no_cap_recipient';

tests.name: Confirm all 105 seeded orders are active

data.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bank_orders WHERE player_id=(SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name='bank05_no_cap_owner') AND enabled=TRUE;

tests.name: Ordinary player creates a 106th active order with no cap refusal
Owner can list the second page beyond the first 100 rows
Assert 106 enabled persisted orders and the new ordinary-player order

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=106 AND COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE bank_orders_id=@{bank05_no_cap_new_order} AND enabled)=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM bank_orders WHERE player_id=(SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name='bank05_no_cap_owner') AND enabled=TRUE;
